scope: Read-only analysis of original shipped Hermes decompilation and assembly; no project modifications.

startup.confirmed: Fresh progress (maxLevel===0), no pending forfeit and no saved game automatically selects level1 and opens game after boot data is loaded. Home PLAY is not required.
routing_priority: pending forfeit: process loss then home
startup.source_progress: AppContent inventory.maxLevel at404141-404143; maxLevel is completed progress rather than merely whether a profile JSON exists.

draw_tutorial.trigger: TUTORIAL.LEVEL>0 and Number(levelId??level.id)===TUTORIAL.LEVEL, one check per mounted board, getItem(key)!="1" and board unsolved.

start.claim: Sets tut phase demo with k0/g0, sets tutShown=true, holds timer and calls tutorial-active(true).

persist_seen.claim: At end of demo sequence, before guide/user phase, asynchronously setItem(draw-key,"1"). It is not delayed until first successful user gesture or entire level win. Rejections are swallowed.

phases.behavior: Synthetic hand down/move/up uses normal drawing callbacks; demonstration piece is locked and tutLock=true. Next demo occurs after handTimeline.total+BETWEEN_MS. Paused/not-laid-out conditions retry after150ms; each attempt index has at most3 retries.
After demo, chooses one remaining target piece, uses idle hint delay500ms; timer tut hold is released on first user touch. Only matching guided target is accepted.
After GUIDE_PIECES successful guided commits (1), sets phase user and clears cells/shape. No new seen-key write.

shape_selection.claim: demoPieces takes level.solution, filters shapes that are current targets and all cells empty, sorts by lowest row-major cell coordinate, takes requested count, returns copied cells. Guide uses next available demoPieces(...,1), falling back to hintPiece(solve budget60000).

interruption.confirmed: Unmount cleanup clears outstanding tutorial timers and dim callback. No serialized tutorial-phase restoration found. If interrupted before the end-of-demo setItem, key remains absent unless async persistence behavior changes externally; reopening level1 may re-run demo. Once write completed, reopening skips entire demo/guide regardless of whether guide was completed.
interruption.qualification: Persistent storage operations are asynchronous and failures are swallowed; exact crash-time survival depends on whether write completed.

board_snapshot_persistence.confirmed_shared_shell: Restoring and sending onStateChange are gated by saveBoardId; callback(null) removes snapshot while nonnull stores it with timeLeft etc.
board_snapshot_persistence.mozaik_evidence: MozaikGameScreen copies incoming props then defines15 properties; no saveBoardId assignment. App GameScreen props also do not supply saveBoardId. Mozaik board entry consumes level/paused/onSolved/startBoosters/onTargetsChange/levelId/timer/tutorial callbacks, with no savedState/onStateChange consumption found.
board_snapshot_persistence.bounded_conclusion: No positive evidence found that original Mozaik saves its demo pieces or restores a partially played tutorial board. Generic shell snapshot support is not proof Mozaik uses it. No explicit phase-specific suppress-save branch located.
board_snapshot_persistence.implementation_implication: Current reconstruction should not allow its own demo-generated resumePieces to prevent the required fresh draw tutorial after interruption; this is a resilience recommendation, not a recovered original phase-specific save suppression instruction.

disabled_mozaik_shell_first_move.conclusion: This shared tutorial exists but is disabled for Mozaik; it is not another active level1 onboarding.

other_tutorials.generic_shared_first_move: Default shared shell firstMove config at351840 uses level1 and @first_move_tutorial_seen, but Mozaik overrides it with level-1.
other_tutorials.conclusion: No second active unsaved-progress tutorial found for Mozaik beyond fresh-start auto-entry and the existing level1 demo→guide→user flow.
